February 23, 8

The Director of Criminal Investigation,
on behalf of the Commissioner of Police, presents
his compliments to H.B.M. Consul and begs to in-
form him with reference to his letter of February
16, 1928 that Douglas James Grant arrived in
Shanghai from Manila about the end of January 1927.
He resided for 9 months at No. 348 Avenue Joffre,
and then removed to No. 373 Avenue Joffre, where
he now resides. Before leaving Manila he was
married to a Russian girl who owns a millinery
shop at their present address. This is their
sole means of support as Grant has been unemployed
since his arrival in Shanghai.

C.F.Garstin, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consul
British Consulate General,
Shanghai.

23/2-28

1928年2月23日

刑事调查处处长谨代表警务处长向大英帝国领事致意，并谨就其1928年2月16日来函告知：道格拉斯·詹姆斯·格兰特（Douglas James Grant）于1927年1月底左右从马尼拉抵达上海。他先在霞飞路348号居住了9个月，随后搬至霞飞路373号，现居于此。在离开马尼拉之前，他与一名俄罗斯女子结婚，该女子在他们现住址经营一家女帽店。由于格兰特自抵达上海后一直失业，此乃其唯一的生计来源。

C.F.加斯廷先生（C.F.Garstin, Esq.），
大英帝国领事，
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
SHANGHAI.

16th February 1928.

H.M.Consul presents his compliments
to the Commissioner of Police, Shanghai Municipal
Council, and will be grateful for information concern-
ing the undernamed:--
DOUGLAS JAMES GRANT.
A letter dated November 29th, 1927 was received from
his mother who resides at 37, Dalrymple Road, Crofton
Park, London, S.E.4, who gives the following partic-
ulars. He was employed in the firm of Messrs. Smith
Fell & Company, Manila, until January 15th 1927, when
he sailed for Shanghai. Further information is that
on September 15th he was still in Shanghai, but since
that date correspondence addressed to him has not been
answered. His mother is very anxious to know what has
become of him.

（批：For. See 16/7/28）

Captain E.I.M.Barrett, C.I.E.,
Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
SHANGHAI.

（批：[签名]

英国驻上海总领事馆。

1928年2月16日。

大英帝国领事谨向上海公共租界工部局警务处长致意，并恳请提供有关下述人员的信息：——
道格拉斯·詹姆斯·格兰特（DOUGLAS JAMES GRANT）。
其母住于伦敦东南4区克罗夫顿公园达尔里姆普尔路37号（37, Dalrymple Road, Crofton Park, London, S.E.4），她于1927年11月29日来信，提供了以下详情。他在马尼拉的史密斯·费尔公司（Messrs Smith Fell & Company）任职，直至1927年1月15日乘船前往上海。进一步的消息是，截至9月15日他仍在上海，但自该日期以来，寄给他的信件均未得到回复。其母非常焦急地想知道他的下落。

（批：外交部。见1928年7月16日）

E.I.M.巴雷特上尉，印度帝国勋章获得者（Captain E.I.M.Barrett, C.I.E.），
警务处长，
上海公共租界工部局，
上海。

（批：[签名]
